description: Implement EncoderBackend using AMD Advanced Media Framework (AMF) for H.264/H.265 hardware encoding on AMD GPUs. Uses AMF's DX11 surface submission for zero-copy from DXGI capture. Handles: AMFFactory init, encoder component creation, surface allocation from DX11 textures, rate control (CBR/VBR), and async output polling. Critical for AMD GPU users — no NVENC available.
title: AMD AMF encoder backend
